index.title: Automate Grocery Shopping
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Grocery Shopping. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Automate Grocery Shopping. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a different job
index.what_happened_excerpt: This person connected their online grocery accounts to a calendar and scheduled regular grocery orders and added cooking plans, demonstrating a method to automate grocery shopping.
